ambiguities.source_text: Find the sum of customers that qualify for each type of byte category
ambiguities.intent: Count input records for each category and gender; do not sum sales or count distinct names.
For any category without one gender, output 0.0 in that gender percentage cell.
ambiguities.source_text: Pivot so that females and males have their own field

ambiguities.intent: Trim gender labels and normalize case to Female and Male.

ambiguities.source_text: Points that are greater than or equal to 7 categorise them as "MegaByte"
ambiguities.intent: Use MegaByte at rounded loyalty points >=7, Byte at >=5 and <7, otherwise No Byte.

ambiguities.source_text: For every £50 spent they get 1 loyalty point
ambiguities.intent: Divide Sale Total by 50, round points to one decimal; fractional points are retained, not floored to whole points.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the percentage of females and males in each category (round the percentages to 1 decimal place)
ambiguities.intent: Divide gender record count by all customer records within the same category and multiply by100; round percentages to one decimal.
